title.zh: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP
title.en: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP

current_state.zh: South Korea's KOSPI index plummeted over 7.6% in one day, halting trading and capping a 40% drawdown from June that wiped out more than $2 trillion in market value, exceeding the nation's annual GDP.

updates.title_zh: KOSPI 抹去韩国一整年的 GDP
updates.title_en: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP
updates.what_changed_zh:
韩国 KOSPI 指数周四收于 5,554 点，单日下跌 7.6%；盘中一度下挫 9.3%，触发 20 分钟的交易暂停，这是该指数今年第 10 次熔断。跌势延续至连续第七个交易日，指数较 6 月高点回撤超过 40%，市值蒸发逾 2 万亿美元。

逾 2 万亿美元的市值缩水，超过韩国 2025 年约 1.9 万亿美元的全年经济产出，也超过全球所有比特币约 1.6 万亿美元的总价值。此次暴跌还使韩国股市从全球第六位跌至第十位——6 月时其市值还在 5 万亿美元之上。

三星电子与 SK 海力士合计约占 KOSPI 市值的一半，并贡献了 6 月见顶以来 70% 的跌幅。散户通过杠杆单一股票 ETF 放大了波动，韩国财政部长已就推出这类产品道歉；韩国金融委员会主席周四召开紧急会议，要求金融机构“保持警惕”，并“积极应对，以确保金融市场稳定和投资者保护”。

updates.background_zh: KOSPI 于 1983 年推出，以 1980 年 1 月 4 日为基准日、基点 100，是韩国主要的市值加权股价指数，在韩国国内的关注度堪比美国的标普 500 指数。高盛将本月的抛售与 2020 年 3 月和 2011 年 8 月相提并论——这是过去 20 年 KOSPI 交易中仅有的两次抛售如此严重且没有反弹日的行情。7 月是 KOSPI 自 2008 年全球金融危机以来表现最差的月份，而 10 月的跌幅已接近 7 月全月水平。熔断（交易限制机制）是交易所为遏制恐慌性抛售、避免无序定价而实施的临时停牌措施。
updates.background_en: KOSPI, launched in 1983 with a base value of 100 as of January 4, 1980, is South Korea's principal capitalization-weighted stock index and is followed domestically much as the S&P 500 is in the US. Goldman compared this month's selling to March 2020 and August 2011 — the only two episodes in the past 20 years of KOSPI trading with selling this severe and without a rebound day. July was the KOSPI's worst month since the 2008 global financial crisis, and October is already nearing that entire loss. Circuit breakers, or trading curbs, are exchange-imposed halts designed to prevent panic selling and disorderly pricing.
updates.market_impact_zh: 在一个由两家 AI 芯片公司主导权重的指数中出现如此规模的跌幅，叠加监管层的紧急会议，强化了全球避险基调；这种基调历来通过市场情绪和跨资产相关性传导至加密市场，文章本身即以比特币约 1.6 万亿美元的总价值作为衡量此次损失规模的标尺。韩国散户在单一股票杠杆 ETF 上的头寸被动平仓，可能成为削减加密交易场所可用投机性流动性的一个渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: A drawdown of this scale in an index dominated by two AI-chip names, combined with an emergency regulatory meeting, reinforces the global risk-off tone that has historically transmitted to crypto through sentiment and cross-asset correlation; the article itself uses bitcoin's roughly $1.6 trillion total value as the yardstick for the size of the losses. The unwinding of leveraged Korean retail positions in single-stock ETFs is a channel through which speculative liquidity available to crypto venues could shrink.
